'''''Ornithogalum arabicum''''' is a species of [[Ornithogalum|star of Bethlehem]] native to northern Africa and southern Europe.<ref>{{cite web | url = http://ww2.bgbm.org/_EuroPlusMed/PTaxonDetail.asp?NameId=38176&PTRefFk=500000 | title = Details for: Ornithogalum arabicum | work = The Euro+Med Plantbase Project}}</ref><ref name=GRIN>{{GRIN | access-date = 19 January 2018}}</ref> Common names include '''Arab's eye''', '''lesser cape-lily''', and '''Arabian starflower'''.<ref name=NSW>{{NSW Flora Online|author= |genus=Ornithogalum |species= arabicum }}</ref><ref name=GRIN/>
[[Image:Ornithogalum arabicum JPG1b.jpg|thumb|right]]
